character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Cute 64-bit pixel-art female astronaut character, full body, transparent background, no scenery. Dark brown skin, huge expressive brown eyes, rosy cheeks, enormous flowing golden-yellow hair, white-and-yellow astronaut helmet with blue visor reflections and pink side detail, bright pink and white futuristic space suit with Saturn emblem, white padded gloves, rainbow-striped legs, chunky white knee pads, and adorable purple/lavender astronaut boots with white cuffs and yellow accents. Cheerful low-gravity pose, slightly floating with one leg lifted. Crisp square pixels, bold dark outlines, vibrant retro-game palette, detailed blocky shading, polished 64-bit video-game sprite, charming futuristic Moon mission aesthetic.
